rapport_notes: Responsive and solution-oriented — offered a cheaper weekday date to save the customer money, which closed the sale.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'do you have any important concerns or instructions about this particular move?' — asked right at the top of the call, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer flagged a real scheduling constraint (recipient's limited availability tied to the date); rep said 'I see, okay, no problem, that should work' and pivoted straight to pricing with no follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'if it takes shorter than that, that's fine, you only pay for how long it takes after the two and a half hour minimum.'

top_strength: Asked the agenda/concerns question before any probing, and saved the sale by proactively offering a cheaper weekday date.
coaching_note: When the customer flagged a real date constraint, it was acknowledged and dropped rather than dug into — a quick follow-up would show she was really heard.
